watches.name: Hamilton Model 23 - Pocketwatch, Luminous Hands
watches.description: Hamilton Model 23 — Built to Time the Mission Fully restored by our in-house watchmakers in the U.S. The hands remain faithful to their era by day, with newly added luminescence for visibility in low light. Produced during World War II, the Hamilton Model 23 chronograph served U.S. Army Air Forces navigators, helping measure the critical intervals on which aerial navigation depended. Its bold black dial places legibility first: contrasting white numerals, a central chronograph seconds hand, a 30-minute recorder, and a separate running-seconds display. Beneath it, a 19-jewel mechanical movement brings together everyday timekeeping and the precise measurement of elapsed time. Every detail reflects its purpose. Every glance recalls an era when navigation depended on instruments, calculations, and the skill of the crew. An enduring piece of American watchmaking—and a tangible connection to the men who navigated the skies. Model: Hamilton Model 23 Chronograph Era: World War II Origin: U.S.A. Movement: Hand-wound mechanical Jewels: 19 Movement Size: 16-size Chronograph: Central stopwatch seconds with a 30-minute counter at 12 o’clock Running Seconds: Subdial at 6 o’clock Dial: Black with white Arabic numerals Case: Approximately 50–51mm, plated base metal Crystal: Glass, as originally supplied Caseback: Solid, screw-on

watches.name: GCT
watches.description: An American icon, masterfully restored. Re-engineered for the wrist. The watch that helped guide American and Allied forces begins a new chapter with Bernhardt. The GCT honors that legacy through painstaking restoration and thoughtful engineering, bringing a piece of American history to your wrist. At its heart is a restored 22-jewel 4992B movement. An exhibition caseback reveals history in motion, framed by an exceptionally thin 47mm diameter case in brushed 316L stainless steel. A domed sapphire crystal completes the profile, while the crown has been carefully repositioned from twelve to three o’clock. The original hands are meticulously restored—faithful to their era by day, newly luminous after dark. A premium USA-made alligator leather strap completes the watch. The GCT is a labor of reverence. History preserved. A new chapter, on your wrist. Specifications · Movement: Restored U.S.-made 4992B, 22 jewels · Case: 47mm, brushed 316L stainless steel · Crystal: Domed sapphire · Caseback: Exhibition · Crown: Repositioned to three o’clock · Hands: Restored originals with renewed luminosity · Strap: Premium alligator leather, made in USA

watches.name: The Pioneer - Blued hands
watches.description: American history, made wearable. In a compact 36mm case. At its heart is an original American pocket-watch movement from Elgin Watch Company—built during an era when American watchmaking stood among the finest in the world. Bernhardt’s in-house watchmakers have carefully restored and reimagined it as a modern wristwatch, preserving the character that made it worth saving in the first place. The dial is the soul of this piece. A pristine enamel dial , sharply printed in black and finished with classic Roman numerals. This isn’t manufactured nostalgia. It’s history preserved so perfectly it could have been made yesterday — yet impossible to duplicate today. The strap is U.S. made, premium leather with brushed rivets and accent stitching. Beneath the sapphire exhibition caseback is a beautifully decorated Elgin movement, alive with fine decoration. No longer hidden behind a solid caseback, it deserves to be seen. The movement is housed in a purpose-built 316L stainless-steel case with sapphire crystal. The case measures a modern 36mm, giving the watch exceptional comfort and fit. It wears far slimmer and more elegantly than its pocket-watch origins would suggest. Manifest is not a reproduction. It is not a tribute. It is American watchmaking history, thoughtfully transformed by Bernhardt and given a second life on the wrist. The past is not gone. It has simply changed form. Circa 1920s · Piece Unique Specifications Collection: Bernhardt Manifest Origin: Historic American Elgin pocket watch Conversion: Completed by Bernhardt’s in-house watchmakers Movement: Decorated, manually wound Illinois mechanical movement, adjusted to three positions Jewel count: 15 jewels Dial: Original enamel dial, black printed, Roman numerals. Case: 316L stainless steel Case diameter: 36 mm Case thickness: ~ 12mm Front crystal: Scratch-resistant sapphire crystal Caseback: Sapphire exhibition caseback Strap: U.S. made, premium leather with brushed rivets Character: Each watch is inherently unique due to its historic components and preserved patina Assembly and finishing: Completed in-house by Bernhardt in the USA

watches.name: x Haven - Shadowgraph
watches.description: You asked us for a chronograph. So we called the American watch company that knows mechanical chronographs inside and out: our friends at Haven Watch Company. Together, we created the Shadowgraph . It felt like the perfect collaboration. Haven is built around Precision with Personality — bold watches, unexpected color, and serious mechanical watchmaking. Think of the tie-dye Chilllton chronograph featured in Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery . At Bernhardt, we tend to lean a little more classic, while still keeping things distinctly modern. The Shadowgraph sits right between the two. We started with a deep black dial, reminiscent of our Midnight Binnacle Diver, then opened it up with three translucent subdials that reveal the movement beneath . Red, luminous subdial hands provide just enough color. The dial carries the Bernhardt name exclusively , while Haven leaves its fingerprints in the details: the Haven “H” on the crown and an etched map of the Great Lakes on the caseback — a signature of the brand. And because Haven exclusively builds around Swiss movements, we knew exactly what belonged inside: a Swiss mechanical chronograph movement , paired with the everyday wearability we expect from every Bernhardt watch. At 38mm , the Shadowgraph wears compact and balanced while retaining the presence and functionality of a true mechanical chronograph. A classic 6–9–12 layout , date aperture at 3 o’clock, and hand-wound modified Sellita SW510MBHa bring the mechanics to life. This isn’t a chronograph designed for the collection box. It was made for the wrist. Two independent American watch companies. One mechanical chronograph we think was worth the wait. watches.name: The Architect - 3194
watches.description: American history, made wearable. In a compact 36mm case. At its heart is an original American pocket-watch movement from Waltham Watch Company—built during an era when American watchmaking stood among the finest in the world. Bernhardt’s in-house watchmakers have carefully restored and reimagined it as a modern wristwatch, preserving the character that made it worth saving in the first place. The dial is the soul of this piece. A pristine enamel dial , sharply printed in black and red and finished with classic Arabic numerals. This isn’t manufactured nostalgia. It’s history preserved so perfectly it could have been made yesterday — yet impossible to duplicate today. The strap is U.S. made, premium leather with brushed rivets and accent stitching. Beneath the sapphire exhibition caseback is a beautifully decorated Waltham movement, alive with fine decoration. No longer hidden behind a solid caseback, it deserves to be seen. The movement is housed in a purpose-built 316L stainless-steel case with sapphire crystal. The case measures a modern 36mm, giving the watch exceptional comfort and fit. It wears far slimmer and more elegantly than its pocket-watch origins would suggest. Manifest is not a reproduction. It is not a tribute. It is American watchmaking history, thoughtfully transformed by Bernhardt and given a second life on the wrist. The past is not gone. It has simply changed form. Circa 1920s · Piece Unique Specifications Collection: Bernhardt Manifest Origin: Historic American Waltham pocket watch Conversion: Completed by Bernhardt’s in-house watchmakers Movement: Decorated, manually wound Illinois mechanical movement, adjusted to three positions Jewel count: 15 jewels Dial: Original enamel dial, black and red printed, Arabic numerals. Case: 316L stainless steel Case diameter: 35 mm Case thickness: 12-13mm Front crystal: Scratch-resistant sapphire crystal Caseback: Sapphire exhibition caseback Strap: U.S. made, premium leather with brushed rivets Character: Each watch is inherently unique due to its historic components and preserved patina Assembly and finishing: Completed in-house by Bernhardt in the USA

watches.name: The Cipher Diver - BG - Fall 2026 Pre-Order
watches.description: Pre-order. Quantities Limited. Ships Fall 2026! Inspired by the covert ingenuity that helped secure America’s independence, the Cipher Diver is a mechanical dive watch with a secret. At a glance it’s everything a proper dive watch should be—300 meters of water resistance, exceptional execution, BGW9 Super-LumiNova, and a remarkably thin 11mm profile. But hidden beneath the sapphire bezel lies something more. A UV-reactive cipher (patent pending), completely invisible in daily wear and revealed only when illuminated. Using time itself as the reference, messages can be encoded and decoded directly on the watch. The previous release sold out in hours. This return refines the concept—now featuring a bi-directional bezel for faster cipher use, and five new colorways. Each Cipher Diver includes a UV decoding torch and the first encoded message (on the caseback). New ciphers will be released weekly throughout our nation’s 250th year and through 2027. Built to be worn daily. Designed to be discovered over time.

watches.name: Starboard - Seafarer Field Watch - Bracelet
watches.description: The Starboard is a nautical field watch built for those who navigate life with precision and a sense of adventure. Limited to 100 numbered pieces, it pairs a 39mm brushed stainless steel case with an ocean-blue textured dial reminiscent of a ship’s deck. Super-LumiNova filled hands and markers provide excellent low-light readability, while the modified Miyota 9132 automatic movement is regulated to +/- 5 seconds per day. A custom 24-hour day/night indicator completes one full rotation each day, offering a poetic depiction of the sun and moon in motion. Final assembly, testing, and regulation are completed in the United States, bringing together maritime inspiration, everyday durability, and refined Bernhardt design.

watches.name: Tempest - Field Watch - Bracelet
watches.description: The Tempest is a refined field watch built for changing conditions. Designed with a 39mm titanium carbide-coated case, it pairs rugged durability with polished details and everyday wearability. Its forged carbon dial captures the chaotic beauty of a storm-lit sky, ensuring no two watches are exactly alike. Powered by a modified Miyota 9132 automatic movement regulated to +/- 5 seconds per day, the Tempest features a custom 24-hour day/night indicator that completes one full rotation each day, offering a poetic depiction of the sun and moon in motion. Limited to 100 numbered pieces, the Tempest balances field-ready function with elevated design.

specsRaw.Tempest is our take on the modern field: rugged enough for daily wear, refined enough to dress up, and distinctive enough to stand apart.

watches.name: Outpost GMT - Bracelet
watches.description: The Outpost GMT is a field-ready True GMT inspired by the mountains of Western North Carolina. Designed for real travel, it features a 40mm stainless steel case and is powered by the Miyota 9075 movement with an independently jumping local hour hand. A full-lume BGW9 dial reveals a hidden mountain silhouette after dark, while maintaining high contrast legibility in daylight. Limited to 100 pieces, the Outpost GMT balances technical capability with purposeful design.

watches.name: Tempest - Limited Edition (Bernhardt x Rampart Studio)
watches.description: Limited to 10 Pieces! We don’t do many collaborations. When we do, the idea has to feel worth it. Rampart Studio came to us with one. Take the Bernhardt Tempest — with its signature sun-and-moon subdial that completes one full rotation each day — and retool the display as a 24-hour military time indicator . Also, refinish the subdial in deep purple with white printing Also, do all the work in-house, in the United States . So we did. The result is a watch that feels unmistakably Bernhardt, but with Rampart Studio’s artistic fingerprint. These pieces were a labor of love, and we’re genuinely thrilled with how they turned out. We couldn’t decide whether the watch looked better on steel or suede, so we decided not to choose. Each one ships with both steel and suede bracelets. About Tempest Tempest is the perfect Bernhardt Field Watch. Rugged enough for all conditions. Beautiful enough for formal wear. Super-LumiNova filled hands and markers provide excellent readability in low light, while the forged carbon dial captures the chaotic beauty of a storm-lit sky (and ensures no two watches are exactly alike). Finished with a titanium carbide-coated case, Tempest strikes a confident balance between durability and refinement. Limited to 100 numbered pieces. Specs: Limited Edition of 10 39 mm x 46mm x 11.5mm (20mm lug width) Modified Miyota 9132 automatic movement In-house UV printed subdial Titanium Carbide PVD Case with Recessed Sides and Polished Chamfers Forged Carbon Dial, ensuring no two are the same Custom Rotating Day/Night 24H Indicator Sapphire Display Caseback Custom PVD Bernhardt Rotor Double Coated Anti-Reflective Sapphire Crystal Super-Luminova A-BGW9, X1-GL-Gray, and X1-Yellow Signed screw-down crown 100 meters water resistance 2 year warranty

watches.name: Retro World Timer - Burgundy Dial
watches.description: Now more than ever we live our lives on a global scale. Doing business across time zones and at our own pace. Traversing the world for leisure and adventure. And we know it can be hard to keep track of everything while still keeping an eye on the time. With this in mind we've brought back the Retro World - featuring an internal rotating bezel to t rack multiple time zones, you'll never forget where you've come from or where you're going. 41mm x 47mm x 13mm (22mm lug width) Miyota 9015 Automatic Movement C1 Super-LumiNova on Hands and Indices Internal Rotating Bezel Marked with 24 Global Timezones 316-L Stainless Steel Case Stainless Steel Shark Mesh Bracelet 200M/660FT Water Resistance Sapphire Crystal and Caseback 2 year warranty 163g weight

watches.name: Tempest - Field Watch - Strap
watches.description: The Tempest is a refined field watch built for changing conditions. Designed with a 39mm titanium carbide-coated case, it pairs rugged durability with polished details and everyday wearability. Its forged carbon dial captures the chaotic beauty of a storm-lit sky, ensuring no two watches are exactly alike. Powered by a modified Miyota 9132 automatic movement regulated to +/- 5 seconds per day, the Tempest features a custom 24-hour day/night indicator that completes one full rotation each day, offering a poetic depiction of the sun and moon in motion. Limited to 100 numbered pieces, the Tempest balances field-ready function with elevated design.

watches.name: Starboard - Seafarer Field Watch - Strap
watches.description: The Starboard is a nautical field watch built for those who navigate life with precision and a sense of adventure. Limited to 100 numbered pieces, it pairs a 39mm brushed stainless steel case with an ocean-blue textured dial reminiscent of a ship’s deck. Super-LumiNova filled hands and markers provide excellent low-light readability, while the modified Miyota 9132 automatic movement is regulated to +/- 5 seconds per day. A custom 24-hour day/night indicator completes one full rotation each day, offering a poetic depiction of the sun and moon in motion. Final assembly, testing, and regulation are completed in the United States, bringing together maritime inspiration, everyday durability, and refined Bernhardt design.

watches.name: Mesh Bracelet - 22mm
watches.description: The Bernhardt 22mm Mesh Bracelet offers a refined, comfortable fit with the added convenience of removable links for precise sizing. The brushed stainless steel mesh drapes smoothly on the wrist while maintaining the durability and strength of a traditional bracelet. Removable solid links allow you to size the bracelet exactly to your wrist without cutting or special tools beyond a standard link pin driver. A stainless steel deployant clasp provides secure closure and a clean look, with the Bernhardt name engraved on the clasp. This bracelet gives your watch a sleek, modern profile while delivering everyday comfort and adjustability.
